weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid/end: a cup of water drains with '563,883 left of 750,000' and 'only 74% stay'. The narration says 750,000 km² was LOST and that this is bigger than France. The cup shows the loss as the amount REMAINING, invents a 74% figure, drops France entirely, and a cyan ellipse covers the headline number.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic 'leaking vessel' machine was picked for a cumulative-total-vs-reference claim. It counts down from the value it should be building up to, and it has no second quantity for the France comparison.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the cumulative loss GROWING to 750,000 km² next to a France-sized outline, for example a cleared patch of forest spreading year by year until it overflows a France silhouette (551,695 km²). The number should count UP to 750,000, with no invented percentage and no mark covering the text.
